title: hubHomeLive
responsibility: Words the Live overview: stage, run state, age and summary labels, and why no overview can be shown.

inputs.name: stageLabel.stage
inputs.description: The planning stage Tracker records, or null when it reports none.

inputs.name: workStateLabel.row
inputs.description: The row whose run state and latest recorded outcome are worded.

inputs.name: span.from
inputs.description: The earlier moment, as an ISO time.

inputs.name: span.now
inputs.description: The current time in milliseconds.

inputs.name: workAge.row
inputs.description: The row whose run age and last change are worded.

inputs.name: workAge.now
inputs.description: The current time in milliseconds.

inputs.name: workTimes.row
inputs.description: The overview row whose start or queue time and last Tracker change are written out.

inputs.name: workFacts.row
inputs.description: The row whose owner, computer and model are listed.

inputs.name: liveSummary.overview
inputs.description: The overview being totalled.

inputs.name: projectWorkCounts.project
inputs.description: Project snapshot with its running count, item totals and summarized work rows.

inputs.name: liveNotice.reading
inputs.description: What the linked computers last answered, or null before the first answer.

inputs.name: liveSystemNotice.reading
inputs.description: The current data or connection state used to select an offline or system alert.

outputs.name: stageLabels
outputs.description: The words for each of the four planning stages.

outputs.name: workStateLabels
outputs.description: The words for each run state.

outputs.name: statusWords
outputs.description: The words for each Tracker task status.

outputs.name: stageLabel
outputs.description: The stage in words, or that the stage was not reported.

outputs.name: workStateLabel
outputs.description: The run state in words, with the recorded outcome when there is one.

outputs.name: span
outputs.description: The elapsed time in its largest whole unit.

outputs.name: workAge
outputs.description: How long the run has been going or waiting, and how long ago the task changed.

outputs.name: workFacts
outputs.description: Owner, computer and model, each saying so when Tracker does not know it.

outputs.name: liveSummary
outputs.description: The totals of live runs, the computers they run on and the projects listed.

outputs.name: projectSummary
outputs.description: The non-zero counts of a project in one line.

outputs.name: liveNotice
outputs.description: Why no overview can be shown, or null when there is one to show.
